title: External stock alert projection
description: Stock-alert lifecycle whitelist without private calculation, evidence, actor, or guard-detail payloads.

resolved_at.description: Optional and NOT emitted by v1 (OD-C28-STOCK-ALERT-RESOLVED-01, owner decision 08-09-2026). The provider models stock alerts as an append-only event stream (op_stock_alert_event): each evaluation writes a new row carrying status, and no resolved or closed column exists, so there is nothing to populate. This is a model mismatch, not missing data - the information is available another way. Consumers derive resolution by reading the most recent event for the same sku_id and warehouse_id: a status of STOCK_OK means the alert is resolved, and that event's occurred_at is when it resolved. Consumers MUST NOT treat the absence of resolved_at as a defect, and MUST NOT infer that an alert is still open from it.
